Alternative profile-level recovery is compose an unconfined shell/fs backend so escalation fields are not advertised, then restart host/session, but that is a deliberate config change, not an in-session workaround. Do not retry denied approvals or modify DSH.

Additional critical admin sync finding: scheduled announcements never auto-activate. AnnouncementRepository.create stores future items as SCHEDULED, but activeForUser filters strictly status=ACTIVE and there is no scheduler/status refresh; after startsAt they remain invisible forever. Likewise expired rows remain displayed ACTIVE/SCHEDULED in admin lists despite EXPIRED being a defined status. Fix repository with refreshLifecycle(now): mark elapsed ACTIVE/SCHEDULED as EXPIRED, then due SCHEDULED as ACTIVE (set publishedAt if null), invoked before list/get/activeForUser/stats. Add repository/route regression tests around due scheduled and expired lifecycle.

Precise interim t3 handoff (mutation blocker confirmed):

ROOT CAUSES / DOM-API CONTRACT MISMATCHES
1) Announcement lifecycle is internally inconsistent. Repository.create returns ACTIVE when startsAt<=now or SCHEDULED otherwise; it never creates DRAFT. Yet DELETE allows only DRAFT and admin.js renders Delete only for DRAFT, making delete unreachable/unusable. admin.js also lists EXPIRED, but no code transitions ACTIVE/SCHEDULED rows to EXPIRED. Most critically, activeForUser filters status=ACTIVE, so future SCHEDULED rows never auto-activate when startsAt passes.
2) Admin announcement PUT exists but admin.js renders no Edit action/form, so title/content/window/audience correction is unavailable in management UI.
3) User-tag PUT supports name/color/description/risk, but admin.js Edit sends only {riskLevel}; repository update unconditionally assigns description=null, so every risk edit silently erases description. UI also exposes no rename/color/description edit controls.
4) Assign-tag route loads valid tags but repository silently filters unknown IDs; API returns 200 with unchanged assignments, so UI toast says “已打标” even though nothing happened. List users for nonexistent tag similarly returns empty 200, indistinguishable from a real empty tag.
5) TAGGED announcement accepts an arbitrary tagId; nonexistent IDs create invisible broadcasts. Create/update lack title max validation, update lacks blank/content/level validation, and tag fields silently truncate at repository boundaries. Global StatusPages maps constraints to generic 409 “数据冲突”, which is non-actionable for duplicate/oversize operations.

EXACT BACKEND PATCH
A) AnnouncementRepository: add refreshLifecycle(now) transaction logic: expire ACTIVE/SCHEDULED where expiresAt<now; activate due SCHEDULED where startsAt<=now<=expiresAt and set publishedAt if null. Call before list/get/activeForUser/stats. Decide draft semantics explicitly: recommended POST creates DRAFT unless request has publishNow/schedule=true; least-contract-change alternative keeps auto ACTIVE/SCHEDULED but remove unreachable DRAFT/delete UI. Because current UI text says blank startsAt=immediate, least-risk is keep auto publish and change delete contract/UI, but product should choose.
B) AdminEnhanceRouting announcement create/update: trim then reject title blank/>200, content blank/>4000; validate level for update too; require TAGGED tagId nonblank, <=80, and userTagRepo.getTag(tagId)!=null; normalize ALL tagId=null; validate times without overflow.
C) UpdateUserTagRequest add clearDescription:Boolean=false. Repository update only writes description when req.description!=null || clearDescription; null+clear=true clears. Validate name nonblank/<=60, description<=300, color Regex("^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$"), risk enum, duplicate name excluding same ID. Preserve omitted fields.
D) Assignment route: distinct IDs, reject blanks, require all requested IDs exist before assign; return 400 with unknown IDs. GET tag users first require getTag(id), else 404.

EXACT ADMIN UI PATCH
- Add announcement Edit button invoking PUT with prefilled modal; represent server 400/404/409 message in toast.
- Either add explicit Draft checkbox/action and make POST draft-capable, or remove dead DRAFT/Delete affordances from API/docs. Do not leave unreachable state.
- Replace tag risk-only prompt with edit modal for name/color/description/risk; send clearDescription only when user explicitly clears.
- After assignment, verify returned list contains tagId before success toast (defense in depth).

TESTS
1) Repository lifecycle: manually/through create make future SCHEDULED, advance now/refresh and assert ACTIVE+visible+publishedAt; expired ACTIVE/SCHEDULED -> EXPIRED+not visible.
2) Route: nonexistent TAGGED tag 400/404; valid tag works; oversized/blank title/content and invalid update level/color/name/description all 400.
3) Create tag with description, PUT risk only, GET/list asserts description preserved; PUT clearDescription true asserts null.
4) Assign unknown/mixed tag IDs returns 400 and inserts none; nonexistent tag users returns 404.
5) Browser E2E: edit announcement and full tag fields, invalid API error toast, failed assignment never displays success.

Additional CRITICAL root cause from static trace: ChatListViewModel marks SK_DIST as controlOnly and simply skips the entire event (lines ~2200-2206). For inactive chats it never decrypts/installs the incoming sender-key distribution, so the immediately following group message decrypt returns NoSession; only opening history later may recover. Fix should process SK_DIST on IO for inactive chats (decrypt pairwise envelope, then processSenderKeyDistributionEnvelope), persist raw control row idempotently, and keep it excluded from unread/preview/notification. Also direct/SK_DIST NoSession recovery calls ensureSession(token,senderId) with default device 1, ignoring envelope.senderDeviceId; multi-device senders can never repair the right session. Expose/parse envelope sender device id and use it for repair.

One more message-key/replay bug in SignalProtocol.decryptMessage legacy no-ciphertextType branch (~1014): it catches broad InvalidMessageException around BOTH PreKeySignalMessage construction and cipher.decrypt. DuplicateMessageException subclasses InvalidMessageException, so a duplicate PREKEY is swallowed and retried as SignalMessage, then surfaces Failed instead of Duplicate. Add catch (DuplicateMessageException) { throw e } before InvalidMessageException. Typed v2/v3 paths are unaffected; this repairs legacy replay classification and prevents false decrypt-failure/crash handling.
